image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a large, iridescent soap bubble being held or formed by human fingers. The bubble dominates the frame, displaying vibrant rainbow interference patterns (greens, pinks, yellows) and significant optical distortion of the background. Smaller satellite bubbles are visible near the bottom left. The background is blurred, showing hints of red and dark tones, likely clothing or skin.

artifact_observations.location: Center-right edge of the main bubble
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary of the bubble seems to merge indistinctly with the finger holding it. There is a lack of clear surface tension definition at the contact point, making it look like the liquid is melting into the skin rather than resting on it.

The smaller bubbles in the foreground/background have inconsistent refraction. Some appear as flat white outlines rather than volumetric spheres, lacking the expected environmental reflection/distortion seen in the main bubble.

The depth relationship between the fingers and the bubble is slightly ambiguous. The focus plane shifts abruptly, causing some parts of the hand to look unnaturally sharp while adjacent areas blur excessively, suggesting minor depth map inconsistency.
